name: Apiflow Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted API development and testing platform with REST/WebSocket testing, mock servers, OpenAPI import/export, workspaces and team collaboration; upstream states no paid feature limits or per-user quota for the software.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires Docker Compose and MongoDB plus your own server/storage; external AI model providers may charge separately. Change the documented default admin password before production use. This entry does not promise free hosted infrastructure.
